title: Dear friend,

lines.text: The winter has been long and quiet here. Snow on the iron bridge,
fog on the river, and the lamp in the window burning late.
I keep your letter in my coat. I read it on the train
and the whole grey city seems to hum with something warm.
Will you come home in spring?
